    NavToggle

    NavToggle extends UI Toolkit Toggle. Whenever its value changes, it publishes a Toggle address together with the new bool value.

    <nav:NavToggle name="music"
               label="Music"
               value="true"
               toggle-category="Settings"
               toggle-key="Music" />
    Attribute Default Description
    toggle-category Default Button catalog category
    toggle-key Empty Toggle key within the category

    The public Toggle property returns the combined UIKey. An empty Category or Key logs a [NavToggle] warning when the value changes and does not send an event.

    Connect it to the graph

    1. Register the address under Key Catalog's Button tab. There is no separate Toggle catalog.
    2. Assign it to NavToggle in UI Builder.
    3. Choose + Add Output > UIToggle to create one or more Toggle ports on the active UI node.
    4. Select the same address and choose a condition:
    Condition Matches
    On true only
    Off false only
    Any Either value

    Do not combine Any with On or Off for the same address, and do not repeat a condition; the graph compiler treats overlapping routes as an error.

    Application code can publish the same event with:

    UINavigationEvents.RequestToggle("Settings", "Music", enabled);

    NavToggle keeps the standard Toggle API, binding behavior, and USS styling. The package adds the ui-navigation-toggle USS class.
